user.title: Set up Scheduler Service
user.description: Create a scheduler service with calendar

error.duplicate_scheduler_name: A scheduler with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
error.empty_scheduler_name: Please enter a name for the scheduler.

add_schedule.title: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Select the type of schedule to create

configure_date.title: Configure date schedule
configure_date.description:
Create a schedule based on specific dates (e.g., March 15 to June 20)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

configure_week.title: Configure week schedule
configure_week.description:
Create a schedule based on week of month (e.g., First Monday of March to Last Friday of June)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

configure_nth_day.title: Configure nth day schedule
configure_nth_day.description:
Create a schedule based on nth occurrence of a weekday (e.g., Second Tuesday of March, 2 days before to 3 days after)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

configure_holiday_country.title: Select holiday country
configure_holiday_country.description: Choose the country whose holidays you want to use for this schedule.

configure_holiday_category.title: Select holiday category
configure_holiday_category.description: Choose which holiday category to use for this schedule.

configure_holiday.title: Configure holiday schedule
configure_holiday.description:
Create a schedule based on a named holiday. The selected holiday is looked up from the Python `holidays` library each year, and then the day offsets are applied.

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

remove_schedule_confirm.title: Remove schedule
remove_schedule_confirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove {schedule_name} ({schedule_type})?

default_configuration.title: Default configuration
default_configuration.description: Set the default YAML configuration for this service. This will be used when a schedule doesn't have its own configuration.

import_holidays.title: Import holidays
import_holidays.description: Select a country to import holidays from.

import_holidays_categories.title: Select holiday categories
import_holidays_categories.description: Choose which types of holidays to include from {country}.

import_holidays_select.title: Select holidays to import
import_holidays_select.description: Choose specific holidays to import as schedules. Each holiday shows its detected pattern type.

data.overwrite_existing: Overwrite existing schedules with same name
data.skip_on_overlap: Skip holidays that overlap with existing schedules
data.include_country_name: Include country name in schedule names

data_description.overwrite_existing: If enabled, existing schedules with the same name will be replaced.
data_description.skip_on_overlap: If enabled, holidays that would overlap with existing schedules will be skipped.
data_description.include_country_name: If enabled, the country code will be added to schedule names (e.g., 'Independence Day (US)'). If disabled, only the holiday name will be used (e.g., 'Independence Day').

error.duplicate_name: A schedule with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
error.duplicate_scheduler_name: A scheduler with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
error.invalid_week_schedule: This week-based schedule does not create a valid recurring date range. Adjust the week type or weekday selection.
error.schedule_overlap: This schedule overlaps with an existing schedule.
error.invalid_holiday_selection: The selected holiday is no longer available. Please choose it again.
error.no_holidays_available: No holidays are available for the selected country and category.
error.no_countries_available: No countries available for holiday import
error.no_holidays_imported: No holidays were imported. All selected holidays were already present or would overlap with existing schedules.
error.no_holidays_selected: Please select at least one holiday to import

abort.no_schedules: No schedules to edit or remove
abort.no_countries_available: No countries available for holiday import
